audience: a parent or patient-group leader without medical training

sentences.text: Mucopolysaccharidosis type 4B is curated as caused by the gene GLB1, while GM1 gangliosidosis is linked to GLB1 only by an inferred roll-up from subtypes at confidence 0.475 [e_ebcdbdec8f81] [e_4b6a2b49884c].
Constellate computed that the two conditions share this gene, but at the lower confidence of 0.475, and it may not hold for every form [e_7bb7feb7a260].
That shared-gene link is inferred, meaning it was calculated and is not a separate database finding [e_7bb7feb7a260].

GM1 gangliosidosis has two studies on ClinicalTrials.gov, a prenatal gene transfer study not yet recruiting and a recruiting study of an oral drug called nizubaglustat [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
A research grant for an AAV approach is recorded, and a patient group link comes from unverified text mining [e_d8e337b6892d] [e_b7708b486598].
For type 4B, two low-confidence features are curated, a thickened lining of heart arteries and pointed hand bones [e_2593001334ed] [e_f6db5c8cf813].
Intellectual disability is listed for type 4B but marked as contradicted [e_2acca2d359f2].
These edges do not show that the GM1 studies apply to type 4B, and they do not show that any drug works [e_7bb7feb7a260] [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
